findings.summary: Shipping ci.yml in this diff makes two pre-existing, unstaged documentation claims concretely false rather than aspirational, and neither is corrected here: AGENTS.md's 'What CI can and cannot enforce' table still says 'the ten text/build gates | ✅' (actual: 14 pre-commit-stage hooks declared, 12 execute after the two SKIPs) and marks check-test-integrity '✅ only with CHECK_RANGE', while .pre-commit-config.yaml's header comment says 'CI runs them explicitly, once per commit in the range' for the same hook.
findings.failure_scenario: check-test-integrity is stages:[commit-msg] in .pre-commit-config.yaml, and this diff's ci.yml only ever runs `pre-commit run --all-files` at the default pre-commit stage -- it never invokes the commit-msg stage, so check-test-integrity does not run in CI today regardless of CHECK_RANGE. A contributor who reads AGENTS.md's row 214 ('✅ only with CHECK_RANGE') rather than row 216 (correctly '⚠️ needs explicit invocation') on the same page, or reads .pre-commit-config.yaml's header, concludes a weakened test assertion will be caught in CI. It will not be -- the new M0.25 row this very diff adds already states the true fact ('Until it lands check-test-integrity does not run in CI at all'), so the tree now contains a self-contradiction across three files. Neither AGENTS.md nor .pre-commit-config.yaml is staged in this commit, so this cannot block M0.7 and is recorded as a follow-up rather than fixed here to avoid widening this commit's scope.
